description: Pharmacist rulings 601, 704 and 705: "Report a symptom or safety concern" for one of the signed-in user's running, paused or ended (completed or abandoned: it stays ended) experiments, at any time, outside the check-in schedule (POST /me/experiments/:id/safety-report). Offer it whenever the user mentions a symptom, a reaction, a warning sign or a pregnancy or breastfeeding change during an experiment, without waiting for the next check-in. First relay `safetyReport.emergencyLine` from supstack_experiments_get word for word. `answers` maps `safetyReport.questions` ids to the user's answers: every one is required, "not-sure" is an answer. Never answer for the user. The result carries `safetyAction` exactly as a check-in does: relay its heading and instruction FIRST, word for word. If `paused` is true the experiment is paused: do not suggest the next dose or a check-in, and do not tell the user to stop prescribed medicines. A report never counts as a check-in and never moves the schedule. To clarify ONE earlier saved answer (`safetyReport.savedAnswers`, her W705 text in `safetyReport.clarify`), pass `clarifies` { reportNumber, questionId, kind: situation-changed (default) or entered-by-mistake } and answer only that question (and its follow-ups): the report names the answer it clarifies, resolves only that answer's status hold and only with a definite answer, and never lifts a pausing answer (`clarification.restrictionKept`). A mistaken answer that PAUSED the experiment is corrected with supstack_experiment_correct and `reportNumber` (her W706 text in `safetyReport.correct`). Relay the `saved` text as sent. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiment_report_safety
